protocol.scope: Remeasure all four frozen H18/H19 cohorts as a diagnostic; H19 is the active research priority.
protocol.selection: Keep original factors, selections, universe membership, entry and exit dates. No reranking or period exclusion.
protocol.outcome: Price plus compulsory reorganization stock and gross cash entitlements, theoretical fractional quantities. Ordinary dividends/JCP omitted consistently. Not total return or executable net P&L.
protocol.cash: Mandatory cash at face value with payment date, separately classify paid cash and unpaid receivable. No reinvestment or interest. No tax assumptions.
protocol.shares: Use final verified successor ratios and historical ISINs. Mark uncredited stock entitlements at successor quote with explicit availability note; never claim proceeds available for reinvestment.
protocol.subscriptions: No external capital, no subscription exercise and no assumed sale of rights. Retain original share count and value rights at zero, including before expiry. Explicit price-only policy, not a claim that rights are worthless or total return is measured.
protocol.failed_entry: Only when primary source confirms the exact requested instrument ceased before entry, keep the full intended allocation as cash at zero interest. Do not buy successor retroactively, reroute order, reweight peers or award merger entitlements. Other missing endpoints remain unknown.
protocol.quality: All resolved terms require saved primary documents. Unexplained jumps over 30 percent remain unresolved, except exact previously registered raw quote reviews. Across compulsory conversion boundaries compare the entire resulting basket with prior close. No arbitrary correction inferred from prices.
protocol.gate: Reuse original fixed halves, minimum periods, IC and adverse missing scenario, 36/72 bp haircut and 0.0042/month hurdle; no threshold tuning.

budget.explanation: Four additional execution/entitlement-policy variants counted conservatively. Same historical cohorts, not independent evidence. Earlier adaptive search unknown.

protocol.next_decision: If H19 clears the screen, evaluate complete cash/dividend and small-capital execution before promotion to replication. If it fails, do not search parameter variants merely to reverse the result. Preserve H18 control and negatives.
